scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PboeVariant=client
scripts.android:apk:admin: npm run android:sync:admin && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PboeVariant=admin
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=client cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:admin: npm run build:android:admin && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=admin cap sync android
scripts.build:android: VITE_BEO_APP_TARGET=client vite build && node scripts/check-android-dist.mjs --variant=client && node scripts/check-bundle-boots.mjs && node scripts/check-phonepe-native-target.mjs
scripts.build:android:admin: VITE_BEO_APP_TARGET=admin vite build && node scripts/check-android-dist.mjs --variant=admin && node scripts/check-bundle-boots.mjs && node scripts/check-phonepe-native-target.mjs
scripts.build:client: VITE_BEO_APP_TARGET=client vite build && node scripts/check-android-dist.mjs --variant=client && node scripts/check-bundle-boots.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run generate:api:check && npm run build && node scripts/check-phonepe-native-target.mjs
